title: yielding russian beef bake
description: a paleo-friendly russian dish featuring a savory beef filling, topped with a sweet and crunchy caramelized onion crust, all in one convenient bake.
instructions: in a large skillet, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium-high heat. add the beef strips and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
remove the beef from the skillet and set aside. add the remaining 2 tablespoons of oil, then add the onion and mushroom. cook until the onion is translucent, about 5 minutes.
add the garlic, tomato paste, beef broth, vanilla sugar, salt, and black pepper to the skillet. stir to combine.
add the cooked beef back to the skillet and stir to coat with the onion mixture.
transfer the beef mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
bake for 30 minutes, or until the beef is cooked through and the onion is caramelized.
